contentText: More than 3,000 people have been killed in the anti-government protests in Iran, yet another rights group, the US-based rights group HRANA, reported on Saturday, noting that the authorities’ brutal crackdown largely appeared to have quelled the unrest. After more than 200 hours of an internet blackout, a monitoring group said at least some connectivity seemed to be back. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.
